value.rationale: Pillai singled out positive restoring-force coefficients as a physical design criterion and gave only p>=2m sufficient at arbitrary order, with a special m=2 sharp result. The new necessary-and-sufficient frontier solves the natural entire parameter family and identifies linear stiffness as sole obstruction by a structural log-concavity lemma; it approaches m/log(3), a substantial, order-uniform enlargement of the feasible region, not a recalculation of one numeric example.
